The heated steering wheel, dual-zone climate control, and massage-equipped seating provide comfort throughout the year, while the available advanced driver-assistance features including lane departure warning, following distance indicator, and automatic high beam control contribute to confident, connected driving. The hands-free liftgate and power rear liftgate make loading cargo effortless.

Visit our showroom to experience the 2019 Cadillac XT4 Sport firsthand and discover why this compact luxury crossover deserves a place in your driveway.
